quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #18
										  					
  

30 Questions • Passing Score 24

questions.question: Drivers must obey instructions from:

options.text: Other drivers with broken-down vehicles on the road.

questions.explanation: Drivers must obey flaggers. They direct traffic to keep drivers and workers safe.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that the right lane is ending. Be ready for traffic to merge.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that pedestrians may be crossing the road. Watch for people crossing.

questions.question: If your tires lose contact with the road, you should:

options.text: Shift into a lower gear to slow down.
Pump the brakes hard and fast.

questions.explanation: If your tires lose grip, ease off the gas and avoid braking. Wait until your tires grip the road again before stopping or turning.

questions.question: Driving while taking medication that impairs your driving is permitted:
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drive under the influence of any substance that impairs your driving. This includes alcohol, prescription and over-the-counter medications, and illegal drugs.

questions.question: What is the thinking of defensive drivers?

options.text: Other drivers will do the right thing.
They expect mistakes from others and prepare to react.
They expect no breaks and give none.

questions.correctAnswerText: They expect mistakes from others and prepare to react.
questions.explanation: Defensive drivers anticipate what other drivers might do wrong and are ready to respond safely.

questions.question: When driving in fog, use:
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog. High beams reflect back at you and make it harder to see.

questions.question: Should you always drive slower than other traffic?

options.text: No, driving too slowly blocks traffic.
Yes, it is a good defensive driving technique.

questions.correctAnswerText: No, driving too slowly blocks traffic.
questions.explanation: Drive slower when there is heavy traffic or bad weather. However, driving too slowly and blocking normal traffic flow is illegal.

questions.question: A broken yellow line between two lanes means:

options.text: Both lanes go in the same direction.

questions.explanation: A dashed yellow line means you can pass when there is no oncoming traffic in the passing lane.

questions.question: Remove snow, frost, and ice from:

options.text: Just the windshield and passenger window.

questions.explanation: Clear all windows and mirrors of snow, ice, and frost before driving. You need to see clearly in all directions.

questions.question: When a school bus stops on the road to load or unload children, what must you do?

options.text: Stop completely until all children have left the bus.
Stop completely until the red lights stop flashing and the stop arm is pulled back.
Change lanes, drive slowly, and pass the bus carefully.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely until the red lights stop flashing and the stop arm is pulled back.
questions.explanation: When a school bus has flashing red lights and its stop arm out, you must stop completely. Wait until the lights stop flashing and the stop arm is pulled back before moving. Even after the bus moves, do not go until you know no children are crossing in front of you.

questions.question: How do stopping distances and crash severity change with vehicle speed?

options.text: They decrease as vehicle speed increases.
They are not affected by vehicle speed.
They increase as vehicle speed increases.

questions.correctAnswerText: They increase as vehicle speed increases.
questions.explanation: Stopping distances get longer and crashes become more severe when vehicles travel at higher speeds.

questions.question: When can you legally block an intersection?

options.text: If you entered on a green light.

questions.explanation: Do not enter an intersection unless you can drive completely across before the light turns red. Blocking an intersection is illegal, and you can receive a citation.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a pedestrian crosswalk is ahead.

questions.question: When must you show proof of insurance to a police officer?

options.text: Only if you are in a collision.
If you are in a collision or stopped for a citation.
Only if you are stopped and cited.

questions.correctAnswerText: If you are in a collision or stopped for a citation.
questions.explanation: You must carry proof of insurance whenever you drive. Show your proof of insurance and license to an officer whenever you are stopped for a traffic stop or are in a collision.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about hazards ahead. This sign warns you that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Be ready for traffic to merge into your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready for traffic to merge into your lane.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic will merge in from the right. Be ready to let the incoming traffic merge safely.

questions.question: At a red light with a green arrow, when can you proceed in the direction of the arrow?

options.text: After you come to a complete stop.
If you are in the correct lane and the road is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: If you are in the correct lane and the road is clear.
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can proceed in that direction when you are in the correct lane and the road is clear. This is true whether the arrow appears alone or with another signal.

questions.question: A truck or bus is making a right turn where you also need to turn right. What should you do?

options.text: Turn quickly before the truck or bus.
Wait until the truck or bus finishes turning before you turn.
Squeeze between the truck or bus and the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until the truck or bus finishes turning before you turn.
questions.explanation: Do not try to squeeze your vehicle between a turning truck or bus and the curb. This can cause a serious crash. Wait until the truck or bus completes its turn before you make your turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: An orange and red triangle on a vehicle means:
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles display an orange and red triangle on the back. Examples include farm tractors, road maintenance vehicles, and horse-drawn carts.

questions.question: Driving slower than other traffic is:

options.text: A good idea if the weather is bad.
Okay if you don't know the speed limit.
Often unsafe because frustrated drivers may take dangerous risks to pass you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Often unsafe because frustrated drivers may take dangerous risks to pass you.
questions.explanation: Driving slower than traffic around you can be dangerous. Drivers behind you may become impatient and take unsafe risks to pass you.

questions.question: This speed limit sign means:

options.text: You must go the posted speed through intersections.
The maximum speed is 55 mph under good road conditions.
You cannot go slower than the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum speed is 55 mph under good road conditions.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum speed allowed on this road. You may drive slower if conditions require it, but you cannot drive faster than this limit.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers that traffic will merge from the right lane. Be ready to allow merging traffic to enter safely.

questions.question: A solid yellow line and a broken yellow line mark the center of the road. If the broken line is next to your lane, it means:

options.text: You cannot pass in this area.
You may pass other vehicles on the left if no oncoming traffic is coming.
You may only turn right in this area.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may pass other vehicles on the left if no oncoming traffic is coming.
questions.explanation: When a broken yellow line is next to your lane and a solid yellow line is next to the other lane, passing is allowed from your side.

questions.question: To turn quickly, your hands should be:

options.text: On opposite sides of the steering wheel.
Next to each other at the top of the steering wheel.
At the top and bottom of the steering wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: On opposite sides of the steering wheel.
questions.explanation: Place both hands on opposite sides of the steering wheel. This position lets you turn safely and quickly on highways.

questions.question: A driver should:

options.text: Look straight ahead at their car.
Focus only on the center of the road.
Look ahead, to the sides, and in mirrors.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look ahead, to the sides, and in mirrors.
questions.explanation: Good drivers watch all around their vehicle. You must know what is happening in front, beside, and behind you at all times.

questions.question: Strong wind on highways:
questions.explanation: Wind can cause problems for all drivers. It can blow dirt and dust onto the road, reducing visibility. It can also physically push a vehicle across the lane.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You may use this lane in either direction.

questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that traffic comes from both directions on the road ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Reduce your speed when the road is wet.
The road ahead has sharp turns and curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce your speed when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet. Slow down when you see this sign.
